name: LUPUS
source:
Sometimes you have to leave your home land not on your own.
Your main character is Grey, wolf, who, as a result of chaotic events, finds himself in the mysterious world of Lupus. It would seem that a free vacation, but not everything is as smooth as it seems.
Will Grey be able to return home, use the help of a local researcher, and also find out what really happened that day?

[From [url=https://pascaloz.itch.io/lupus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有时候，离开故土并非出于自己的意愿。
主角格雷是一只狼，在一连串混乱的事件后，来到了神秘的卢普斯世界。看似白捡了一场假期，事情却远没有想象中那么顺利。
格雷能否借助当地研究者的帮助，返回家乡，并查明那天究竟发生了什么？

[摘自[url=https://pascaloz.itch.io/lupus]Itch.io[/url]]
